name: One-time Code
description: A six-digit verification code input that rolls digits in, ripples on paste, shakes wrong codes away and fuses into a single Verified pill on success.

props.name: onVerify
props.description: Runs as soon as the last digit lands. Resolve { ok: true }, { ok: false, reason: "invalid", attemptsLeft }, { ok: false, reason: "expired" } or { ok: false, reason: "locked" }.

props.name: onResend
props.description: Sends a fresh code. The countdown restarts once it resolves.

props.name: onChangeDestination
props.description: Inline “Edit”: send a code to a new address. Resolve when sent.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: If set, “Edit” calls this instead of opening the inline editor.

props.name: onVerified
props.description: Called after the merge-to-pill animation settles.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of digits, split into two groups.

props.name: channel
props.description: Sets the glyph, heading and editor input type.

props.name: destination
props.description: Where the code went, shown in full.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading.

props.name: description
props.default: "Enter the 6-digit code we just sent to"
props.description: Lead-in before the destination.

props.name: resendAfter
props.description: Seconds before Resend unlocks.

props.name: footnote
props.description: Fine print under the resend row.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the code on mount.

name: SSO-Aware Sign-in
description: A work-email sign-in that reads the domain as you type: the password folds away, the button becomes Continue with Okta, and shared domains get a workspace picker.

props.name: detect
props.description: Look a domain up. [] keeps email + password; one workspace morphs to SSO; several show the picker. Defaults to a lookup in `directory`.

props.name: directory
props.description: Static domain → workspaces map used when `detect` is not given. Demo domains: acme.com, globex.com, contoso.com, initech.io.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: Quiet time after the last keystroke before the domain is checked.

props.name: onSsoContinue
props.description: Start the redirect. The button shows redirect progress until it resolves; reject with an Error to show its message.

props.name: onPasswordSignIn
props.description: Password sign-in for non-SSO domains. Reject with an Error to show it under the password field.

props.name: email
props.description: Controlled email value. Pair with onEmailChange, or use defaultEmail.

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: Initial email when uncontrolled.

props.name: onEmailChange
props.description: Called on every edit.

props.name: onForgotPassword
props.description: The “Forgot?” link.

props.name: brand
props.description: Product name beside the mark.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the heading.

props.name: signUpHref
props.description: Target of the “Start a free trial” link.

name: Allocation Donut
description: A monochrome allocation donut that sweeps in and morphs between asset class, region and sector; the slice in focus takes the one accent.

props.name: views
props.type: { key: string; label: string; slices: AllocationSlice[] }[]
props.description: Groupings to switch between. Slices: { name, value, target?, change? }, up to 8, largest first so the ramp runs light to dark.

props.name: defaultView
props.description: Key of the view shown first; defaults to the first.

props.name: title
props.description: Card title.

props.name: tolerance
props.description: Drift in percentage points before a slice gets a drift chip.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the hovered or focused slice, its legend swatch, weight bar and centre figure.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with a light-to-dark grey ramp, or a white card with a dark-to-light ramp.

props.name: palette
props.description: Slice colours in order. Keep them neutral: the accent marks the slice in focus.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for values.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for number formatting.

name: Candlestick Chart
description: A trading-desk candlestick chart that grows in candle by candle, with a snapping crosshair, two averages, live ticks, pinch zoom and a range navigator.

props.name: data
props.description: Candles per interval: { t: epoch ms, o, h, l, c, v }, oldest first. Missing intervals fall back to demo data.

props.name: defaultInterval
props.description: Interval selected on mount.

props.name: name
props.description: Asset name in the header.

props.name: pair
props.description: Pair shown in the mono chip.

props.name: venue
props.description: Exchange or data source, hidden in narrow containers.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for the headline price.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for numbers and dates.

props.name: maFast
props.description: Fast moving-average period. 0 hides it.

props.name: maSlow
props.description: Slow moving-average period. 0 hides it.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px; plots under 560px wide use 70%.

props.name: live
props.description: Tick the last candle every 1.4s. Ignored under reduced motion.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one non-data colour: the fast moving average.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or a white card with near-black ink. Up and down colours adjust for contrast.

name: Channel Breakdown
description: A dark ranked breakdown: a share strip grows segment by segment, rows land with counting figures, bars fill, and switching period re-sorts rows on a spring.

props.name: periods
props.type: { key: string; label: string; caption?: string; channels: { name: string; value: number; previous?: number }[] }[]
props.description: One entry per period. Channels are ranked by value; shares are computed from the period total. previous adds a small delta.

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: Period key shown first.

props.name: onPeriodChange
props.description: Called when the period changes.

props.name: title
props.description: Label above the total.

props.name: format
props.description: How values and the total are written.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the leading channel's segment and bar. The rest step down a grey ramp.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for figures.

name: Revenue Trend
description: A dark period-over-period area chart: the line strokes in, its fill rises from the baseline, the total counts up and a spring crosshair reads any day.

props.name: data
props.description: Daily values, oldest first (ISO dates). Supply at least twice the longest range so every range has a previous period to compare with.

props.name: ranges
props.type: { key: string; label: string; days: number }[]
props.description: Range switcher options. The switcher hides with one range.

props.name: defaultRange
props.description: Range key shown first.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Called when the range changes.

props.name: title
props.description: Metric name above the total.

props.name: unit
props.description: Muted suffix after the title.

props.name: format
props.description: How figures and axis labels are written.

props.name: decimals
props.description: Fraction digits for the total and tooltip.

props.name: aggregate
props.description: Whether the headline is the period's total or its mean.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: this period's line, fill and crosshair dot. Monochrome by default.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for every figure.

name: KPI Cards
description: A dark row of selectable KPI cards: figures count up out of a blur, sparklines stroke in, deltas tick, and a 7/30/90-day switch re-counts and morphs every card.

props.name: periods
props.type: { key: string; label: string; caption?: string; stats: KpiStat[] }[]
props.description: One entry per range. Each stat is { key, label, value, previous, format?: "currency" | "number" | "percent", decimals?, series: number[], invert? }. The switcher hides with a single period.

props.name: defaultPeriod
props.description: Period key shown first.

props.name: onPeriodChange
props.description: Called when the period switch changes.

props.name: selected
props.description: Controlled selected stat key, e.g. the metric a neighbouring chart shows. Omit to let the cards manage it.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Initially selected stat when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called with a stat key when a card is pressed.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the row.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: selection ring, selected sparkline and dot. Monochrome by default.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency for currency stats.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for every figure.

name: Orders Table
description: A dark recent-orders table: rows rise in with drawn avatar rings and counting totals, status tabs re-filter on a spring, and it folds into cards in narrow columns.

props.name: orders
props.type: { id; customer; items; channel; status: "Paid" | "Pending" | "Fulfilled" | "Refunded"; total: number; placed: string }[]
props.description: Rows in the order you pass them (newest first). Refunded totals are struck through.

props.name: statuses
props.description: Filter tabs after “All”, each with a live count. An empty filter shows a designed empty state.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading.

props.name: viewAllHref
props.description: Where the “View all orders” link goes.

props.name: viewAllLabel
props.description: Link text.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the active filter's count. Status dots carry semantic colour; nothing else does.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO currency code for totals.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for totals.

name: Sticky Scroll Story
description: A scroll-driven feature story in black and white: a sticky product panel steps through four states, each choreographed in, as the steps scroll past.
usage:
import { FeatureStickyScroll } from "@/components/design-for-ai/feature-sticky-scroll";

<FeatureStickyScroll
  brand="Ledgerly"
  heading="Bookkeeping that"
  headingMuted="does itself."
/>

props.name: heading
props.description: First clause of the heading.

props.name: headingMuted
props.description: Muted second clause of the heading.

props.name: intro
props.description: Intro paragraph.

props.name: steps
props.description: Four steps, each driving one panel state.

props.name: brand
props.description: Product name in the panel.

props.name: items
props.description: Invoice line items.

props.name: pots
props.description: Set-aside shares for the final state.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the progress rail, reached step markers, the timer and Send buttons, the paid ring and your pot.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black (default) or warm paper; the panel, wells and invoice paper follow.

name: ASCII Wordmark Footer
description: A black footer whose giant wordmark is a canvas field of mono characters that sweeps on as you arrive. The cursor is a lens: glyphs scramble and brighten beneath it.

props.name: wordmark
props.description: The giant word. Rasterised with the display face at weight 800 and fitted to the full footer width. Words without descenders read best.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Lines used instead below 560px so the mark keeps enough rows to stay legible. Pass [] to keep one line.

props.name: kicker
props.description: Mono line above the sign-off.

props.name: signOff
props.description: One or two sentences above the wordmark, max 34ch.

props.name: links
props.type: { label: string; href: string; external?: boolean }[]
props.description: The compact link row. Hovering one dims its siblings.

props.name: legal
props.description: Mono legal line under the wordmark.

props.name: legalLinks
props.description: Privacy, terms and similar.

props.name: ink
props.description: Colour of the character field.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the hottest scrambling glyphs under the lens, the reveal's leading edge and the hint dot.

props.name: ramp
props.description: Density ramp, lightest first; the first character is empty space.

props.name: glyphs
props.description: Glyphs the lens scrambles through.

name: Dynamic Island Header
description: A black pill header that morphs like a dynamic island into search, a live deploy notification and an account menu, with a blob spring and blurred content swaps.

props.name: brand
props.description: Home link; the mark sits in a white 30px circle.

props.name: links
props.description: Three links in the idle pill.

props.name: activeIndex
props.description: Current link: full white and aria-current.

props.name: searchItems
props.type: { id, label, kind: "command" | "project" | "doc", hint?, href?, keywords? }[]
props.description: What search filters. Five results show at a time.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a result is chosen (Enter or click). The island folds back afterwards.

props.name: account
props.description: Avatar, the menu header and an optional usage meter (0–1).

props.name: accountItems
props.description: Account menu items; a danger item gets a divider above it.

props.name: notification
props.type: { id, status: "running" | "success" | "error", title, detail?, progress?, action? } | null
props.description: When set and nobody is searching or in the menu, the island morphs to show it.

props.name: onNotificationClose
props.description: Called on dismiss, Escape, or once a success has been up for successHold.

props.name: successHold
props.description: Milliseconds a success stays before folding away. Hovering holds it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the header.

name: Morphing Mega Menu
description: A Stripe-style header whose single dropdown panel morphs its width, height and position between menus, with direction-aware content and a springing caret.

props.name: brand
props.description: Wordmark and home link.

props.name: sections
props.description: Menu triggers and their panels: { label, columns: { heading, links: { label, description?, href, glyph?, badge?, live? }[] }[], feature?, footer? }.

props.name: links
props.description: Plain links after the triggers. Hovering one closes the panel.

props.name: signIn
props.description: Quiet text link on the right.

props.name: cta
props.description: Ink pill button.

props.name: snippet
props.description: Code shown on a feature card with art "code"; its Copy button shows Copied or Blocked.

props.name: defaultOpenIndex
props.description: Open this section on first render (desktop only). The demo opens Products.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: Hover intent before the panel opens, in ms. Moving between triggers while open is instant.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Grace period after the pointer leaves before the panel closes, in ms.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the header.

name: Kinetic Type Hero
description: A type-foundry hero on black: a giant variable-font stack fills out from hairline, then every letter gains weight and leans toward the cursor.

props.name: lines
props.description: The giant stack, one short line each.

props.name: specimen
props.description: Specimen label in the readout.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint under the readout.

props.name: services
props.description: Words in the marquee strip.

props.name: meta
props.description: Mono facts in the meta row under the band.

props.name: metaLink
props.description: Underlined catalogue link at the end of the meta row.

props.name: primary
props.description: Solid accent CTA pill with a white arrow chip.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Underlined text link.

props.name: minWeight
props.description: Lightest weight on the axis.

props.name: maxWeight
props.description: Heaviest weight on the axis.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the final full stop, the weight meter, the CTA and focus rings.

props.name: theme
props.description: Ink on black, or ink on white paper; the marquee band inverts either way.

name: Prism Hero
description: A dark hero where a glass prism splits a hairline beam into a real, Snell's-law spectrum: the beam travels in, the spectrum unfurls, the cursor steers it.
usage:
import { HeroPrism } from "@/components/design-for-ai/hero-prism";

<HeroPrism
  eyebrow="Halide 3 — Event analytics"
  headline="One stream in. Every answer out."
  muted="Every answer out."
  primary={{ label: "Start free", href: "/signup" }}
/>

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono line above the headline.

props.name: headline
props.description: The headline, centred, balanced to at most 14ch.

props.name: muted
props.description: Substring of the headline set at 42% white.

props.name: body
props.description: Supporting paragraph, max 52ch.

props.name: primary
props.description: White pill button; the arrow nudges 2px on hover.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Dark hairline pill that stays legible over the field.

props.name: dispersion
props.description: How wide the spectrum fans, 0–1. 0.5 is restrained; 1 is still tasteful.

props.name: readout
props.description: Show the live incidence and deviation readout beside the prism (wide containers only).

name: Product Stack Hero
description: A dark SaaS hero: headline lines blur in, then three CSS-drawn app windows assemble in a pointer-tilted 3D stack, the burndown draws and one block moves.

props.name: headline
props.description: Headline, one string per line; each line blurs in on its own beat.

props.name: emphasis
props.description: Word set in serif italic (emphasis by voice, not colour).

props.name: body
props.description: Supporting paragraph.

props.name: primary
props.description: Solid ink CTA pill.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Tour link with a play button.

props.name: rating
props.description: Rating line; a numeric score counts up from zero.

props.name: weekLabel
props.description: Calendar window title.

props.name: days
props.description: Day column labels.

props.name: today
props.description: Index of today in `days`.

props.name: now
props.description: Current time as a decimal hour, for the now line.

props.name: events
props.description: Calendar blocks: day, start, hours, title, tone (solid, muted, hatch, accent). The accent block is the one the thread moved and lands last.

props.name: sprint
props.type: { name; status; actual: number[]; total; days }
props.description: Burndown data; the line draws and the points-left figure tracks its tip.

props.name: thread
props.description: Comment card data; `moved` is the chip on the last message.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: now line, moved block and chip, focus rings.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black stage with graphite windows, or cool grey with white windows.

name: AI Prompt Composer
description: A prompt composer with file chips, a model picker, slash commands, live mic levels and token hints. While the agent thinks, a comet of light circles the border.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled request status, the same shape as the AI SDK's useChat. Undefined simulates thinking → streaming → ready.

props.name: error
props.description: Message shown with Retry when status is "error".

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with { text, model, attachments } on Send or ⌘/Ctrl+Enter. Only finished uploads are included.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Stop button (and Escape) while thinking or streaming.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry button in the error strip.

props.name: models
props.description: { id, name, description, tag? } for the model popover.

props.name: defaultModel
props.description: Model id selected on mount. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onModelChange
props.description: Called when a model is picked.

props.name: commands
props.description: { name, description } suggestions shown after typing /.

props.name: maxTokens
props.description: Budget for the token hint (≈ chars / 4). Amber past 80%; over it, Send disables.

props.name: maxFileSize
props.description: Bytes. Larger files become error chips.

props.name: accept
props.description: accept attribute for the file picker.

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Upload one file and report progress 0–1. Reject to show an error chip with Retry. Defaults to a simulated upload.

props.name: defaultAttachments
props.description: Chips to start with (status uploading | done | error).

props.name: microphone
props.description: "real" asks for the microphone with getUserMedia and records with MediaRecorder.

props.name: onTranscribe
props.description: Turn a recording into text; the result is appended to the prompt.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Textarea placeholder.

name: Live Delivery Sheet

props.name: restaurant
props.description: Shown in the glass top chip and beside the kitchen pin.

props.name: orderNumber

props.name: etaMinutes

props.name: etaClock

props.name: routeKm

props.name: progress

props.name: live
props.description: Simulate the courier riding on (paused under reduced motion).

props.name: courier

props.name: steps

props.name: items
props.description: Order lines: qty, name, optional detail, unit price.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol.

props.name: deliveryFee
props.description: Delivery fee.

props.name: serviceFee
props.description: Service fee.

props.name: address
props.description: Delivery address.

props.name: note
props.description: Courier note, shown in quotes.

props.name: tips
props.description: Tip amounts for the sliding segmented picker; the total tweens.

props.name: initialSnap
props.description: Snap point the sheet springs up to on mount.

props.name: onSnapChange
props.description: Fired when a snap is chosen.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back button.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Message the courier.

props.name: onCall
props.description: Call the courier.

name: Assistant Chat

props.description: Name in the glass header and accessibility labels.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Fired when the stop button interrupts a reply.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back button in the header.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Fired by the schedule card’s reminder button.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: The composer’s + button.

props.name: onOpenLog
props.description: The header’s care-log button.

name: Now Playing

props.description: Playlist or album the queue plays from.

props.name: sourceLabel

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: Track to start on.

props.name: initialTime

props.name: initialVolume

props.description: How strongly the cover lights the screen, from 0 (pure black glass) to 1.

props.description: Rows in the AirPlay popover: name, detail and kind (phone, speaker, mini, display).

name: Comparison Matrix

usage:
import { PricingComparisonMatrix } from "@/components/design-for-ai/pricing-comparison-matrix";

<PricingComparisonMatrix
  plans={plans}        // { id, name, price, unit, blurb, cta }[]
  groups={groups}      // { name, features: { name, hint?, values }[] }[]
  recommendedId="team"

props.name: plans

props.name: groups

props.description: Near-black or white surfaces; both are tuned.

name: ASCII Object
description: A Three.js torus knot rendered entirely in mono characters from a runtime glyph atlas, with edge-aware stroke glyphs, a hover torch and drag-to-spin inertia.

props.name: shape
props.description: A 2,3 torus knot, or a square torus with chamfered edges twisted three quarter-turns.

props.name: ramp
props.description: Characters from empty to dense; the first should be a space. ASCII_RAMPS exports classic, fine and blocks. Updates live.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Character cell height in CSS px; width is 0.6×. Rounded to whole device pixels so glyphs stay crisp. Updates live.

props.name: color
props.description: Glyph tint. Brightness within the tint follows the lighting.

props.name: background
props.description: Fill behind the glyphs.

props.name: edges
props.description: Draw silhouettes and self-overlaps with directional stroke glyphs ( - / | \ ) found by a depth Sobel.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Idle spin in rad/s; resumes 1.2s after a drag. 0 holds still.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag to turn with inertia, hover torch, arrow-key nudges.

props.name: onGridChange
props.description: Called when the character grid changes size.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description; a sensible default names the shape.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the host, which fills its parent.
